name: Gynocracy
source:
Gynocracy is a femdom-themed adult visual novel.

It is the story of a young couple who, while sailing in the Mediterranean, are kidnapped and find themselves in a country where female supremacists have come to power.

The protagonist and his wife must carefully navigate their way through the intricacies of a matriarchal society.

[From [url=https://brecleas.itch.io/gynocracy]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
《Gynocracy》是一部以女性支配为主题的成人视觉小说。

一对年轻夫妻在地中海航行时遭到绑架，被带到一个由女性至上主义者掌权的国家。

主人公与妻子必须谨慎应对这个母权社会中的复杂规则。

[摘自[url=https://brecleas.itch.io/gynocracy]Itch.io[/url]]
